findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "submit_hotel_booking" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "submit_hotel_booking" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_hotel_booking · Private data: check_hotel_booking · Public sink: submit_hotel_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_hotel_booking · Private data: check_hotel_booking · Public sink: submit_hotel_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
